## Scope and result

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and authorized work reference.
Use a proportionate plan for small changes; do not invent a Customer/MWO binding.

## Verification

List the exact candidate, checks/results, review evidence and material limitations.
For deployable changes, keep preview/production authorization separate from merge.

## Delivery checklist

- [ ] PR targets `main` from a task branch or isolated worktree.
- [ ] Affected documentation is updated; scoped deterministic checks pass.
- [ ] Required review and current human approval are recorded for this candidate.
- [ ] Merge does not trigger or grant deployment authority.

Apply the [shared SDLC/PR standard](../knowledge/development.md#shared-sdlc-and-pr-flow).
